# INVESTMENT RESEARCH & STRATEGIC APPRAISAL REPORT

**Date:** December 27, 2025  
**Property ID:** 738432  
**Asset Name:** TSAOG RidgeWood Orthopaedic Center  
**Location:** 19138 N US HWY 281, San Antonio, TX 78259  
**Asset Class:** Institutional Class A+ Medical Office / ASC-Anchored Flagship

---

### **I. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY**
The TSAOG RidgeWood Orthopaedic Center is a premier 97,000-square-foot, specialized medical facility serving as the primary regional hub for TSAOG Orthopaedics. Acquired in April 2021 by a joint venture between Anchor Health Properties and The Carlyle Group for $57.0 million ($588/SF), the asset represents a "Generational Core" investment. This appraisal identifies the property as a high-acuity "Surgical Engine" situated in a demographic micro-climate characterized by explosive wealth velocity and aging cohorts that drive orthopedic volume. 

### **II. ASSET SPECIFICATIONS & REPLACEMENT COST**
Approximately 40% of the facility is dedicated to an Ambulatory Surgery Center (ASC). Current 2025 replacement costs for ASC-grade space are estimated at $650–$715/SF, placing the 2021 purchase price at a discount to current reproduction costs.

### **III. OPERATIONAL STAFFING ADVANTAGE**
The market contains a surplus of 337 Anesthesiologists (-163.8 beyond benchmark). This surplus ensures maximum room turnover and mitigates the #1 risk to surgical throughput, providing a significant competitive advantage over clinical facilities in underserved Texas markets.

### **IV. DATA TABLES & BENCHMARKS**

#### **Asset vs. Market Benchmark Comparison**
| Metric | Property 738432 | San Antonio Avg (Q4 2024) | Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Price Per SF** | $588.00 | $341.20 - $365.10 | +61.1% |
| **Average NNN Rent** | $30.23 | $26.25 | +15.1% |
| **Occupancy Status** | 100% | 89.6% | Outperformer |

#### **Specialty Supply-Demand Ratio Analysis (10-Mi Radius)**
| Specialty | Local Count | Benchmark Demand | Gap (Undersupplied) | Ratio |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Orthopedics** | 153 | 91.9 | -61.1 | 1.66 |
| **Anesthesiology** | 337 | 173.2 | -163.8 | 1.94 |
| **Internal Medicine** | 386 | 489.7 | +103.7 | 0.78 |

#### **Revenue & Demand Velocity Matrix**
| Metric | CAGR (5-Yr) | Strategic Impact |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Wealthy HH ($200k+)** | 11.64% | High-margin private PPO procedures. |
| **Age 70-79 Cohort** | 4.34% | Primary driver for hip/knee arthroplasty. |
| **Medicare Enrollment**| 6.58% | Stable reimbursement floor. |

### **V. STRATEGIC CONCLUSION**
The asset has transitioned from a "premium-priced" new build to a "market-supported" institutional anchor. The primary recommendation is a Long-Term Core Hold, with a tactical focus on acquiring primary care assets to address the +103.7 Internal Medicine physician gap nearby.
